card.name: Digits inside gene and enzyme codes
card.fires_on: A single digit (1, 2 or 4) that sits right after a capital letter or two in a short alphanumeric code, such as CYP enzymes (P450, CYP2D6, A2), transporters (B1), p16, T4 or patent codes (B1).

modes.label: Enzyme and transporter names
modes.description: A digit inside a cytochrome or transporter name, such as P450 or ABCB1.
modes.example: Drug Interactions Drugs Metabolized by P<<4>>50 2D6 - The

modes.label: Other short codes
modes.description: A digit in a patent kind code, a protein marker or a hormone abbreviation.
modes.example: US 6543011 B<<1>> A method for recording events in Java

card.plain: It fires on the digit within short letter-and-number codes, mostly enzyme names like CYP2D6 or P450.
